data.name: Inspekta (Great God Grove)
data.description:
Inspekta is one of the eight Gods of the Grove and the first encountered by the Godpoke. He is the God of Leadership and the youngest god in the pantheon. His domain, The God Complex, is located in the Bizzyboys' campaign van. It first appears in The Grove Cove and follows the Godpoke as they progress. As a human, he was known as Hector.



Appearance: Inspekta is a slim god with gray-green skin, shoulder-length teal hair, a round, teal nose, and black eyes with long eyelashes. He has no visible arms or legs, and his hands float independently. In certain expressions, he has sparkly eyes and a long, blue tongue that can extend over his collar. He wears a long red coat with a tall collar, gold lining, and two gold buttons, resembling the uniforms of his followers/underlings, the Bizzyboys. His oversized red hat features a gold brim and a heart design, and he wears gold boots with red trim and outsoles. His tail is partially wrapped in a bandage and taped onto his coat.

As a god, Inspekta possesses the ability to contort his body unnaturally, including bending backward, curling around, and twisting in multiple ways. In the final boss sequence, his coat opens to reveal a torso made entirely of hands. He can also summon additional hands at will.




Personality: Inspekta takes great pride in his status as the God of Leadership, often reiterating his own greatness and importance in his conversations with the Godpoke. It is implied he has a strong sense of responsibility - 30 years before the events of the game, he organized the Bizzyboys and has been their leader ever since.

However, as Godpoke progresses through each area, Inspekta is slowly revealed to be very egotistical, power-hungry ultimately self-serving. He intentionally created mean-spirited letters and attributed them to King so as to fulfil his own plan of keeping the other gods from working together to close the Rift. This was so that every god but himself would be expelled from their place in the pantheon in the resulting chaos, forcing everyone to worship him as the one true god.





Trivia: 
- Inspekta was the last god to be designed for the game.

- Inspekta's tail is taped on, unlike the Bizzyboys', whose tails are real.

- Charlotte from Madoka Magica and Anthy Himemiya from Revolutionary Girl Utena were inspirations for Inspekta's design.

- Inspekta's phonetic dialogue is meant to reflect a thick, exaggerated Brooklyn accent.

Lewk!

OH KING, YOU WRETCH! HOW COULD YOU DO IT?

BUT- -that must be why yewr here!

MY SIDEKICK! MY SECOND IN CO-MANNED!

OH GODPOKE, I KNEW YEW'D THINK SO!

Yewr better than King, I bets we'll be seein' OODLES of each other!

Just follow my lead! Be my backup, buttercup!

Yew're a VALLEY-OOBLE asset! We need to keep yew PRO-TECH-DID!

HAVE NO FEAR! Da mystery WILL be solved in time.

I ain't da God of Leadership for nothin'!

"GOODY JOB ON THE GOODY WORK!"

(End of Chapter Meeting):

Oh spek, oh spek, how could this happen?

I can't believe it. It's a complete travesty!

... Is someone up there?

DEPUTY! Is that yew? Come down here!

There yew are! Thank King yew made it.

I owe yew a big apology... When I saw my boys gearin up ta smack yew... I wanted to scream STOP!!!

Dey'r too excite-a-bull. Dey'll do anything fer my approval... even rough up my favorite deputy.

So accept my apology on their behalf. No foul, no scowl, eh?

BUT THOSE SILLY HEADS DON'T LISTEN TO MY ORDERS!

Anywho, how about that Milldread? Full of lonely weirdos, wouldn't yew say?
(If Yes) Well, that's what ya get for war-shipping a god of CORN, huh? CORN!
But yew still helped them, bless yewr heart. You figured out dey'r troubles and yew... yew solved the case! (If No) Right! Not anymore. Because yew solved dey'r Mister-e!

I knew I saw something in yew, Deputy. Yewr a born detective. A NATURAL GUMSHOE!

Yew may not have the EXPERT training that I have, or such a super cool technology den...
...But yewr still trying your best-est.

Now, if I'm reading my Cyber-Map correctly, you're about to enter HobbyHoo Hills!

Milldread might have been a breeze, but this is a place of ROMANCE! TREACHERY! STAGE ACTORS!

I don't advise a novice such as yewrself try to solve this case.

How about it, deputy. Wanna leave thissun' up to me?

(If Yes) Great! Yew can just enjoy your HobbyHoo vacation, and leave tha crime fightin' up to me!
I'll have tha mystery solved before you can say, "Oh no the world is ending aaaAAAaaaaAAAaaa!" Oh, WHAT mystery? (If No) Oh, I suppose I was just as excited when I was a young human detective. How can I say no? Well here's the scoop!

Yew see, HobbyHoo worships Thespius and Click Clack, two artist-gods who've always gotten along!

That is... until King wrote a letter to Click Clack...

A have a copy on my desk!

Give it a read!

[HOBBYHOO LETTER]

Hobbyhoo is just up ahead. If yew insist on comin' along...

LAST ONE THERE IS A ROTTEN LEG!!!
